### The Seventh Trumpet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-seventh-trumpet
Passage: Revelation 11:15-19
Points:
- Revelation examines the period between Christ's ascension and return through repeating perspectives rather than strict chronological order.
- The blowing of the seventh trumpet announces the arrival of God's full, uncontested reign over the earth.
- Scripture distinguishes between God's sovereign control over creation and a cosmos willingly submitted to His appointed King.
- Christ fulfills Psalm 2 as the divine human King who recovers the dominion forfeited by Adam's rebellion.
- Believers living under Christ's present reign are called to joyful obedience and active proclamation of His kingship.
